The '''Imperial City Exhibition Series''' was a series of [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] games presumably held in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the ruling days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]</ref>
